search_text: published ZDI-19-848 ZDI-CAN-9312 (0Day) Microsoft Windows Storage Service Link Resolution Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2019-09-24 6.1 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:H ['Microsoft'] ['Windows'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Storage Service. title: (0Day) Microsoft Windows Storage Service Link Resolution Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Storage Service. By creating a junction, an attacker can abuse the service to delete the contents of a chosen folder. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
